levels.typicalNeedPattern: Mostly independent; intermittent cueing/setup or limited assistance; no pervasive supervision
levels.baselineCarePackage: Standard support package with low-frequency individualized tasks
levels.reviewEscalation: Routine review; reassess on sustained increase in assistance/frequency
levels.privateCaregiverPrinciple: PCG only for incremental dedicated 1:1 staffing beyond shared L1 package
levels.feeSafeguard: Do not charge PCG for tasks already included in LOC

levels.typicalNeedPattern: Regular assistance in selected ADLs/mobility/toileting/medication or defined supervision; needs remain deliverable through shared staffing
levels.baselineCarePackage: Expanded recurring task package with moderate frequency and condition-specific modifiers
levels.privateCaregiverPrinciple: PCG only when L2 shared staffing cannot safely meet dedicated need

levels.typicalNeedPattern: Multiple dependencies or substantial physical assistance; high-frequency care events, significant mobility/safety burden, or frequent structured clinical support
levels.baselineCarePackage: High-frequency hands-on task package + enhanced monitoring/coordination
levels.reviewEscalation: Closer clinical review; assess staffing burden and capability
levels.privateCaregiverPrinciple: High LOC does not automatically require PCG

levels.typicalNeedPattern: Near-total functional dependency with substantial supervision OR pervasive cognitive/behavioral supervision OR sustained comprehensive multi-domain complexity requiring very high shared-care resources
levels.baselineCarePackage: Comprehensive hands-on care, supervision, prevention, monitoring and coordination package
levels.reviewEscalation: Frequent multidisciplinary/capability review; PCG assessed separately
levels.privateCaregiverPrinciple: PCG may coexist with L4 only when dedicated staffing remains necessary
levels.feeSafeguard: Separate dedicated staffing from comprehensive care package

levels.typicalNeedPattern: Authorized comfort-focused advanced-illness/end-of-life pathway; not a dependency score above L4
levels.baselineCarePackage: Goal-directed comfort care + symptom observation + dignity/family/provider coordination
levels.privateCaregiverPrinciple: PCG only if dedicated staffing is additionally required and within capability
levels.feeSafeguard: PCG cannot substitute for services beyond LifeCare capability

baselineByDomain.L1: Independent; setup/cueing or intermittent minimal help
baselineByDomain.L3: Extensive hands-on help across multiple ADLs
baselineByDomain.L4: Comprehensive/near-total assistance as required, with cognitive/safety adaptations
baselineByDomain.modifierRule: Resident-specific assistance intensity and frequency override generic examples

baselineByDomain.L3: Frequent/substantial physical assist or complex transfers
baselineByDomain.L4: Comprehensive assisted mobility/transfer support with supervision adaptations
baselineByDomain.modifierRule: Fall/mobility modifier adds controls; PCG decision remains separate

baselineByDomain.L4: Comprehensive/high-frequency toileting, hygiene and skin protection
baselineByDomain.modifierRule: Capture episodes/24h + night pattern; high-frequency modifier if material

baselineByDomain.L2: Regular setup/meal assistance or intake observation
baselineByDomain.L3: Frequent meal assistance + structured intake/nutrition support
baselineByDomain.modifierRule: Aspiration/weight-loss modifiers add specific tasks and escalation

baselineByDomain.L1: Self-management where approved or low-complexity support
baselineByDomain.L4: Comprehensive medication support with cognitive/behavioral adaptations
baselineByDomain.modifierRule: Medication changes/risks add monitoring; discrete procedures use DT-014
Acute change uses DT-003; skilled add-on uses DT-014

baselineByDomain.L3: Frequent cueing, behavior observation and defined supervision
baselineByDomain.L4: Comprehensive dementia/BPSD support and close supervision as assessed
baselineByDomain.modifierRule: Diagnosis alone does not set LOC; supervision duration matters

baselineByDomain.L3: Enhanced controls and frequent safety support
baselineByDomain.modifierRule: Dedicated 1:1 requirement is evaluated only after final LOC via DT-013

baselineByDomain.L3: Frequent prevention/skin checks when risk burden is material
baselineByDomain.modifierRule: Active/complex wound treatment may invoke DT-014

baselineByDomain.L4: Intensive individualized communication support if required
baselineByDomain.modifierRule: Score/support communication impairment itself, not diagnosis

baselineByDomain.L4: Comprehensive day/night routine support when materially required
baselineByDomain.modifierRule: Capture actual nighttime interventions and duration
Therapy potential alone does not increase LOC; score staff workload
